title: Patch: every choice of four options or fewer is a Discover of choice cards
thread: **Issue #2646 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #2646: Patch: every choice of four options or fewer is a Discover of choice cards Opened by @MaxGoetzmann. ## What it does Any choice with **4 options or fewer** uses the Discover picker, the way Hearthstone handles Choose One: each option is drawn as a **card**, with art, its name, and as its card text what the option does. These **choice cards are not cards.** They are only how the options are shown. Each one has no cost, stats, rarity, set mark or card id. It never reaches a zone, the log, the collection, inspect or the long-press sheet, and nothing in the engine treats it as a card. #492 started this: a short "Choose one" already uses the `discover` chrome, and `CardChoice` lays it out in the middle of the screen. But an option that names no card is still drawn in `CardOption` as a bare text box (`prompt-card-name` plus `prompt-card-text`), with no art and no frame. Several other short choices (`equip`, `faceDown`, engine `answer` and `reward` prompts) still use the plain button list. This issue commits fully to the card treatment and moves every such picker over to it. ### Where it is today (main @ 672e81c2) - `apps/web/src/game/contract.ts`: `DISCOVER_OPTION_LIMIT = 5`. `e2e/support/playthrough.ts:66` keeps its own copy of it. - `apps/web/src/game/Prompt.tsx`: - `pickerForPending` (route 1, engine prompts) gives `mode` the `discover` chrome at or under the limit. It never calls `modeText`, and it has no asking card, because `PendingPromptView` carries no source. So an engine-opened Choose One shows bare option labels and no explanation. - `pickerForNeed` (route 2, a play being built): `mode` and `ability` are already `discover`. `equip`, `faceDown` and `plague` use the plain `mode`/`number` lists. - `CardOption`: the branch where `face === null` is the text box this issue replaces. - `apps/web/src/game/modeText.ts`: `MODE_TEXT` holds a label and detail for 17 cards' mode options. Any option it lacks prints as its capitalised key with no detail. - `apps/web/src/cards/art/CardArt.tsx`: procedural art by `defId` plus name motif, with `ART_MANIFEST` real art as an override. ## The design 1. **One limit, 4.** Set `DISCOVER_OPTION_LIMIT` to 4 and keep the e2e copy in sync. 5 or more options keep today's list. 2. **A choice-card face** (a new component in `apps/web/src/game/`, beside `CardOption`; it is prompt chrome, not a card face). It has the art window, a name bar (the option's label), and a text box (the option's detail, drawn with `RulesText` so keywords still get their tips). It has **no** cost gem, attack or health, rarity, set mark, foil or Radiant shimmer. Give the frame its own neutral tint (a token in `palette.css`) so nobody mistakes it for a playable card. It is the same size as the real cards in a Discover, so a row of 2 to 4 reads as a Discover. 3. **Art.** `CardArt`'s procedural path draws each option, seeded by `:` (or by the prompt kind and key when there is no source card). The option's label goes in as `name`, so `motifFor` picks a matching motif. Each option gets its own picture, and the same option always gets the same picture. This issue adds no art files. Real per-option art can come later through the manifest, and is out of scope here. 4. **Text.** The card text is the option's `detail`, which is required. A choice card with no detail is a bug, not a fallback: falling back to the bare label is why the cards don't explain themselves today. - Route 2: `modeText(source, option, radiant)` as now. `ability` uses its `usesWords`/ability label. `equip`, `faceDown` and `plague` get a detail line each (for example "Equip: attach it to a unit in this zone", "Stack: play it to the zone as a unit"). - Route 1: the engine prompt needs its asking card. Add an optional `sourceDefId` (and `sourceRadiant`) to the chooser's `PendingPromptView` only, built in `view_for` from the prompt's source. Expose it only when that card is visible to the viewer, by the same `hidden()` test `sourceId` already goes through (R1088). Never put it on `PendingElsewhereView`. This is a **view** field, not a `PendingChoice` field, so state hashes, the fuzz replay hashes and the golden fold stay unchanged. `pickerForPending` then calls `modeText` and titles the picker with `PickerTitle`'s source, as route 2 does. Record the visibility decision as a ruling in this issue's block (`spec/rulings/R000.md`, §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/.md`), and edit the §10.6/§10.8 notes to say so. - **Coverage:** add a test that fails for any card script option offered in a `mode` prompt of 4 or fewer options that has no `MODE_TEXT` entry. Write the missing entries from each card's §8 text. 5. **What stays the same.** The answers (`answer`, `play`, `activate`) and their keys, `data-testid="prompt-option-"`, `data-prompt-kind`, `data-prompt-layout="cards"`, the replay's `readOnly` fold, "View the board" (#1204), keyboard arrow focus, and the `aria-label` (it becomes `"
